// Execute with Node 22: node --input-type=module - /path/to/repository < this-file
// Reads actual fixture expressions from frozen Git objects and compares generated bytes.
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { createRequire } from 'node:module';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';
import vm from 'node:vm';
const repo=process.argv[2];
const require=createRequire(join(repo,'package.json'));
const ts=require('typescript');
const { getAddress }=require('viem');
const baseline='d74af79ebabdc8cead843361c3497b46d8c421f9';
const fixed='008ccdcf05b703cea51ffc4fdaa42fc279281d81';
const read=(ref,path)=>execFileSync('git',['show',`${ref}:${path}`],{cwd:repo,encoding:'utf8'});
const parsed=(text)=>ts.createSourceFile('fixture.ts',text,ts.ScriptTarget.Latest,true);
const all=(source,predicate)=>{const result=[];const visit=n=>{if(predicate(n))result.push(n);ts.forEachChild(n,visit);};visit(source);return result;};
const one=(xs)=>{assert.equal(xs.length,1);return xs[0];};
const decl=(source,name)=>one(all(source,n=>ts.isVariableDeclaration(n)&&n.name.getText(source)===name));
const run=(text,context={})=>vm.runInNewContext(text,context,{timeout:1000});
const sha=(text)=>createHash('sha256').update(text).digest('hex');
const fixturePath='packages/chain-adapters/src/fixtures.testutil.ts';
const fixtureText=read(fixed,fixturePath);assert.equal(fixtureText,read(baseline,fixturePath));
const fixture=parsed(fixtureText);
const fake=decl(fixture,'FAKE').getText(fixture);
const manifest=one(all(fixture,n=>ts.isFunctionDeclaration(n)&&n.name?.text==='manifestJson')).getText(fixture);
const program=ts.transpileModule(`const ${fake};\n${manifest}\n`,{compilerOptions:{target:ts.ScriptTarget.ES2022,module:ts.ModuleKind.CommonJS}}).outputText;
const context={getAddress,exports:{}};run(program,context);const manifestJson=context.exports.manifestJson;
assert.equal(typeof manifestJson,'function');
const path='packages/chain-adapters/src/deployments.test.ts';
const oldSource=parsed(read(baseline,path));const newSource=parsed(read(fixed,path));
const oldArg=one(all(oldSource,n=>ts.isCallExpression(n)&&n.expression.getText(oldSource)==='loadDeployment'&&n.arguments[0]?.getText(oldSource).includes('__proto__'))).arguments[0].getText(oldSource);
const newArg=decl(newSource,'prototypeKeyFixture').initializer.getText(newSource);
const oldBytes=run(oldArg,{manifestJson});const newBytes=run(newArg,{manifestJson});
assert.equal(JSON.stringify(manifestJson())[0],'{');assert.equal(oldBytes,newBytes);assert.equal(Object.hasOwn(JSON.parse(newBytes),'__proto__'),true);
const cspPath='scripts/tests/privacy-csp-bundle.test.mjs';
const oldCsp=parsed(read(baseline,cspPath));const newCsp=parsed(read(fixed,cspPath));
const {BROAD,connectSrc}=await import(pathToFileURL(join(repo,'apps/web/scripts/csp.mjs')));
const configured=connectSrc(['https://rpc.example.invalid','wss://rpc.example.invalid']);
for(const name of ['policy','meta'])assert.equal(decl(oldCsp,name).getText(oldCsp),decl(newCsp,name).getText(newCsp));
const metaProgram=`const ${decl(newCsp,'policy').getText(newCsp)};\nconst ${decl(newCsp,'meta').getText(newCsp)};\nmeta(configured)`;
const tag=run(metaProgram,{BROAD,configured});assert.equal(tag.indexOf('>'),tag.length-1);
const transform=(source)=>one(all(source,n=>ts.isArrayLiteralExpression(n)&&n.elements[0]&&ts.isStringLiteral(n.elements[0])&&n.elements[0].text==='duplicate content after valid policy')).elements[1].getText(source);
const oldTransform=transform(oldCsp);const newTransform=transform(newCsp);
const oldTag=run(`(${oldTransform})(tag)`,{tag});const newTag=run(`(${newTransform})(tag)`,{tag});assert.equal(oldTag,newTag);assert.equal((newTag.match(/ content=/g)??[]).length,2);
console.log(JSON.stringify({format:'ghostpay-independent-fixture-equivalence/1',node:process.version,baseline,fixed,sourceFiles:[path,cspPath,fixturePath],fixtures:[{name:'prototype-member manifest',bytes:Buffer.byteLength(newBytes),sha256:sha(newBytes),exactBytesEqual:true,actualOriginalExpression:oldArg,actualNewExpression:newArg,hostileMemberRetained:true},{name:'duplicate CSP content attribute',bytes:Buffer.byteLength(newTag),sha256:sha(newTag),exactBytesEqual:true,actualOriginalExpression:oldTransform,actualNewExpression:newTransform,duplicateAttributeCount:2}],codeqlClearanceClaimed:false},null,2));
